messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 41):
"""
No Date of approval of subsequent Revision /Modification(s) 9 Date of withdrawal of the product 10 Date of approval of PMC for withdrawal of Product S No Item Particulars (to be filled in by the Insurer) 11 Financial year-wise business details of the product for the preceding three Financial Years (Data to be provided as on the immediate month-end preceding the date of this application) F Y No. of Policies / Riders / Add-ons issued No. of Lives covere d No. of Policies /Riders / Addons in force Gross Premium (Rs.) 12 Expected loss ratio & Combined Ratio (for the product) vis-a-vis the incurred loss ratio & Combined Ratio (Data to be furnished for each Financial Year) (Applicable only for Health and General Insurers) FY Loss Ratio % Combined Ratio% Expected Actual Expected Actual 13 Justification for withdrawal of the product:
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}
